headline: No scored news; lines drift as earlier stories fade
body: A quiet day with no scored events. Scores shifted by only hundredths of a point as the effects of earlier announcements faded. Enslaved God still leads at 40.65, ahead of Conquerors at 35.82 and Self-Destruction at 31.08. Horizon Balance stayed at -13.08, unchanged in practice.
movers_note: No ending moved by 0.1 or more; small drifts in Protector God and Enslaved God came only from earlier events fading.
